draft.emotion: warm and respectful, thinking of a familiar, aging family member
notes: The plural form 'dziadkowie' means both 'grandfathers' and 'grandparents' (grandmother and grandfather together).
Referring to an elderly man as 'dziadek' is informal; addressing a stranger as 'dziadku' can sound rude or condescending.

draftBefore.emotion: warm and respectful, thinking of a familiar, aging family member
notes: Dziadek is the standard term for a grandfather. In Polish, it is also commonly used as a friendly or slightly informal way to refer to any elderly man.

Be aware that calling a stranger 'dziadku' can sound condescending or rude depending on the tone and context; it is best to use it only with people you know well or when being intentionally affectionate.
